verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud hosting platform, so a visual infrastructure canvas is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows CLI-driven workflows (`fly launch`, `fly scale`, `fly machine run`) and a REST API. Nothing documents a visual canvas for viewing or editing the infrastructure stack without config files.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can visualize and edit my entire infrastructure stack on a visual canvas without writing config files
